sound_intent.sample_layer: Sample-based arrangement with textured sample bed providing atmospheric depth, complemented by one-shot hits emphasizing rhythmic accents.
sound_intent.focus: Vocal-focused emotional delivery with slow-building energy.

routing_intent.drums: Route one-shot hit samples and rhythmic texture samples through dedicated drum bus with transient shaping.
routing_intent.bass: Route filtered sub-sample layers with smooth compression on bass bus.
routing_intent.chords: Route layered texture samples with reverb and delay to chords bus.
routing_intent.melody: Route sparse melodic sample slices with subtle modulation effects.
routing_intent.vocal: Route vocal samples with priority, applying emotional processing and dynamic automation.
routing_intent.fx: Route atmospheric and transition samples with spatial processing in fx bus.

track_roles.drums: Provide rhythm and dynamics with one-shot hits and textured samples.
track_roles.bass: Support harmonic foundation with sample-based bass layers.
track_roles.chords: Create harmonic texture using layered sample pads.
track_roles.melody: Add melodic interest with subtle sampled phrases.
track_roles.vocal: Lead emotional storytelling with focused vocal samples.
track_roles.fx: Add atmosphere and smooth transitions with sample-based effects.

designer_intent.goal: Create an emotional trip hop arrangement with slow build energy, emphasizing vocal presence supported by a textured sample bed and impactful one-shot hits.

presetor_intent.goal: Select presets that enhance the emotional vocal delivery and provide rich texture in the sample layers, ensuring clarity and depth.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate rhythmic patterns using one-shot hit samples with controlled dynamics and textures appropriate for trip hop groove.

bass_generator.brief: Produce smooth, sample-based bass sounds that complement the emotional mood and slow build energy.

harmony_generator.brief: Create harmonic textures using layered samples that provide depth without overpowering the vocal focus.

melody_generator.brief: Craft subtle, sparse melodic sample slices that enhance the emotional narrative without clashing with vocals.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement structure and energy build, ensuring smooth transitions and vocal emphasis throughout the piece.

presetor.brief: Apply appropriate sample-based presets with reverb, delay, and modulation tailored to the emotional and slow build characteristics.

songgps.brief: Manage arrangement pacing, energy curve, and section transitions to create a coherent and expressive trip hop piece.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare unprocessed channel audio for mixdown, ensuring clarity of one-shot hits and vocal layers for subsequent mixing.
